sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate represents the missing formula operands or exact equation; the available terms cover applicability, the calculated result, and ship ownership only.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Replace the presence-only radius check with the required equation-based validation. Locate canonical properties for every missing formula operand, compute the expected equivalent impact sphere radius on the ship when nonHemisphericalImpactArea is present, and compare the reported decimal value in metres using a tolerance scaled from the expected result.
